# Shri Kuber Group (SKG)

> Shri Kuber Group is a vertically integrated real estate developer based in Hanumangarh, Rajasthan, India. It develops the land, builds the structure in-house, and intends to operate hospitality within its developments as that side of the firm grows — three disciplines under one accountable roof. Tagline: "The Power of Trust." Positioning: long-horizon and material-honest — "we build places that outlast the conversation about them."

## What SKG does (Develop · Build · Host)
- Develop: land acquisition and assembly, feasibility and underwriting, masterplanning and approvals.
- Build: in-house construction management, material and finish governance, delivery and handover.
- Host: hospitality operations, asset and estate management, guest and resident experience — planned as SKG's third discipline, not yet live on any asset.

## Facts
- Headquarters: #27 City Center Market, Hanumangarh — 335513, Rajasthan, India.
- Operates from Hanumangarh, Rajasthan, and, where a building deserves it, into neighbouring regions.
- Founded: 2001.
- Managing Director: Om Soni. Director: Arvind Soni.
- Sectors: Real Estate Development, Construction, Hospitality.

## Projects
- CCM City Walk — stone-colonnaded retail arcade on a palm-lined boulevard, Hanumangarh (Phase 1, first units open and trading; the rest of the arcade completing bay by bay).
